Namaste, I'm Hema. You're watching This Day, That Year.

hema

Old news. The Reserve Bank's Monetary Policy Committee began a three-day meeting, with its decision due on the seventh. By twenty forty one, the committee still meets, and the country still waits for its announcement.
पुरानी खबर। रिज़र्व बैंक की मौद्रिक नीति समिति की तीन दिन की बैठक शुरू हुई, फ़ैसला सात तारीख़ को आना था।

hema
Old news. Fifteen years ago the headlines were money, interest and housing. By twenty forty one, they are still money, interest and housing.
पुरानी खबर। पंद्रह साल पहले सुर्खियाँ पैसा, ब्याज और घर थीं। आज भी वही हैं।
hema
That is what the archive teaches. The numbers change, and the questions stay in the same order.
अभिलेख यही सिखाता है। आँकड़े बदलते हैं, सवाल उसी क्रम में रहते हैं।
hema
That's the record. Everything else is just a take. I'm Hema. Namaste, see you at the next bulletin.

sarla
Hi guys! It's Stomach Challo, and I have left the country once more. Same shoes, new accent. I love foreign.
sarla
Okay, it is Lonavala. But the hills are so green and the fog is so Scottish. Edinburgh called, and I let it go to voicemail.
sarla
I tried the famous chikki. In Europe they call it a nut bar with a story. Here it comes in a paper bag and a lot of confidence.
sarla
There is a long queue for vada pav at the viewpoint. In Paris, it is called a line for the Louvre. Same patience, less glass.
sarla
The monsoon just left early, so the waterfalls are on a break. Very union, very Switzerland. Even the water takes weekends.
sarla
That's it for today. Stay hungry, stay foreign. This is Stomach Challo, signing off from West India.

jc
Today's product is the Sol Ramu. Fifteen years ago, OpenAI unveiled GPT-6.1 Sol at DevDay, with cheaper cached input. We put the discount into a household robot.

jc
It remembers every question you asked, and charges you a ninety five percent discount for repeating them. It still forgets your birthday.

jc
Second product: the Secret Chai Link. India's first free-space quantum key demo carried a secret code across five point five six kilometres of open air. Our version carries your order to the stall.

jc
At the sunny entrance, the Sol Ramu costs Rs 85,000 and answers like a professor. At the shadow entrance, it costs Rs 1,100 and says you already asked that.

jc
Pay in chai if you like. Chai is Rs 12 at the shadow entrance and Rs 900 at the sunny entrance. Choose your entrance wisely.
